v.en: O God, come to my assistance;

r.en: O Lord, make haste to help me.

source.scope: Psalmi & antiphonæ ex Psalterio secundum diem

text.la: Caríssimi: Estóte prudéntes, et vigiláte in oratiónibus. Ante ómnia autem mútuam in vobismetípsis caritátem contínuam habéntes, quia cáritas óperit multitúdinem peccatórum.
text.en: My beloved: Be prudent, therefore, and watch in prayers. But before all things have a constant mutual charity among yourselves: for charity covereth a multitude of sins.

text.la: Cum vénerit Paráclitus, * quem ego mittam vobis Spíritum veritátis, qui a Patre procédit, ille testimónium perhibébit de me, allelúia.
text.en: But when the Comforter is come * Whom I will send unto you from the Father, He shall testify of Me, alleluia.

text.la: Omnípotens sempitérne Deus: fac nos tibi semper et devótam gérere voluntátem; et maiestáti tuæ sincéro corde servíre.
text.en: O Almighty and everlasting God, grant that our will be ever meekly subject unto thy will, and our heart ever honestly ready to serve thy majesty.
